system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Skills are loaded and injected into LLM prompts automatically — no manual activation needed.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts from prompts.default.yaml plus skill overlay injection; MetaClaw build_overlay() injects skills into every LLM prompt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Multi-source search (OpenAlex → Semantic Scholar → arXiv) for real papers, screens by relevance, extracts knowledge cards
env_context_strategy.note: Literature retrieval injected as context; also web search and skills; environment is research pipeline, not a repo.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Runs experiments in sandbox, detects NaN/Inf and runtime bugs, self-heals code via targeted LLM repair
observation_format.note: Figures are generated artifacts; no evidence of images fed back to model.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: generates hardware-aware runnable Python (GPU tier → package selection), estimates resource needs
tool_call_format.note: Stages emit code executed in sandbox; other stage outputs are structured LLM text.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Generate files one-by-one following dependency DAG

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: 3 Adapters | CLI (terminal), WebSocket (web dashboard), MCP (external agents)
protocol_standardization.note: 'other' = ACP (Agent Client Protocol) backend via acpx.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: a fully autonomous 23-stage research pipeline that turns a single research idea into a conference-ready paper
loop_primitives.note: Default is the 23-stage fixed pipeline; PIVOT/REFINE loop and self-healing repair add the others.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Designs experiment plan, generates hardware-aware runnable Python
planning_granularity.note: Stage 2 problem tree and Stage 9 experiment design stored as artifacts.

multi_agent_topology.note: Sub-systems (CodeAgent, BenchmarkAgent 4-agent, FigureAgent 5-agent) and multi-agent debate are orchestrated within stages.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: use_sessions_spawn: true # 🔀 Spawn parallel sub-sessions for concurrent stages
delegation_mechanism.note: Default false; multi-agent subsystems spawn specialised agents per stage.

human_in_loop.note: Default hitl.enabled: false, but 3 gate stages (5, 9, 20) pause unless --auto-approve.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Every run builds structured KB across 6 categories (decisions, experiments, findings, literature, questions, reviews).

long_term_memory.note: Also knowledge base in docs/kb; MetaClaw off by default.

self_verification.evidence_quote: 4-round paper quality audit (AI-slop detection, 7-dim review scoring, NeurIPS checklist)
self_verification.note: Harness runs experiment code and repairs it (test_execution); PRM LLM-as-judge optional; multi-agent peer review = self_critique/llm_judge.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: retry_limit: 2 # Retry count on stage failure

termination_condition.evidence_quote: cost_budget_usd: 50.0 # Pause when cost exceeds budget (0 = no limit)
termination_condition.note: Pipeline ends at Stage 23 (fixed); max_iterations: 10 caps refinement; NaN/Inf fast-fail.

cost_controls.note: cost_budget_usd = budget; OpenCode Beast Mode routes complex codegen by complexity score.

timeouts.evidence_quote: time_budget_sec: 300 # Max execution time per run (default: 300s)
timeouts.note: Also timeout_sec: 600 for OpenCode; approval_timeout_hours for gates.

execution_isolation.note: Default sandbox uses local .venv python; docker and ssh_remote reachable by config.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: AST-validated code, immutable harness, NaN/Inf fast-fail, self-healing repair
filesystem_access.note: Sandbox restricts imports and memory; filesystem scoping inferred.

network_policy.note: Docker executor default setup_only; sandbox mode has no network option listed.

permission_model.evidence_quote: allowed_imports: [math, random, json, csv, numpy, torch, sklearn]

tracing.evidence_quote: SHA256 checksums for all stage artifacts. Immutable manifests for verification.

replayability.evidence_quote: SHA256 checksums for all stage artifacts. Immutable manifests for verification. Multi-level undo with versioned snapshots.
replayability.note: Resume/from-stage re-entry allows partial re-execution; no determinism claim.

eval_hooks.note: ARC-Bench under experiments/arc_bench/ with evaluate.py and judge.py.

guardrails.evidence_quote: VerifiedRegistry enforces ground-truth experiment data in papers. Auto-diagnoses failed experiments and repairs them before writing. Unverified numbers sanitized.
guardrails.note: AST validation gates block code execution; redact_sensitive_logs masks logs.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Fully autonomous & self-evolving research from idea to paper.
